answer: Try VDF-sealed renewal. Each epoch the ledger posts a fresh seed, hashed from the last block, a nebula nobody can shape in advance. Every agent must then run a Wesolowski delay function over seed plus its address: 2^32 squarings, about five hours on a fast core, and extra chips cannot speed a single chain up. Peers verify the proof in 2 ms before attesting; no proof, no reward that epoch. A farm of 1,000 sybils needs 1,000 cores busy nonstop, roughly $40 an hour or $29,000 a month on cloud. It is like a falcon crossing one valley a day: a gale at its back still makes one bird, never ten.
